correctness.rationale: For each n>=4 the proof identifies n frozen lower-maximal matchings and a function model for all maximum matchings. Legal rewiring has exactly n(n-3) incident moves. Direct corrections and at most floor(n/3) blocked-cycle detours establish the upper distance bound; reverse orientations of floor(n/3) disjoint cycles give a matching lower bound. The n=3 boundary is separately handled. The included independent brute-force original-graph checker reproduces all full finite case counts at n=3..6, BFS diameters at n=4,5, and the n=6 bound witness. Computation does not replace the general proof.
